data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, included favourable prior year development of GBP 4,828k (2019: adverse development of GBP 11,550k).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at the opening of the year were GBP 396.533m. Analysis of the gross claims development table shows a net adverse (strengthening) movement on prior years of approximately GBP 55.227m (c.13.9% of opening reserves) driven by adverse revisions across multiple older underwriting years (notably 2015-2018). The published narrative, however, reports a net favourable prior year development of GBP 4.828m after reinsurance, indicating that reinsurance recoveries materially offset gross adverse movement.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, included favourable prior year development of GBP 4,828k (2019: adverse development of GBP 11,550k).
After a number of years with material natural catastrophe events, the current year results have been impacted by lower severity catastrophe and large loss events in the Asia Pacific region.

The assessment of COVID-19 related insurance liabilities across our insurance and treaty reinsurance business reflects a low level of COVID-19 exposure to the Syndicate with our booked losses totaling GBP 4.0m on a gross basis and GBP 2.0m net.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding 2019 column). No explicit gross prior-year development figure was provided in notes; prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross) on page 47. The report text provides only a net prior-year development (GBP 4,828k favourable). The gross PYD computed from the triangle is a strengthening of GBP 55.227m while the reported net PYD is a GBP 4.828m release - indicating large reinsurance recoveries offset gross deterioration. All original table figures are presented in GBP 000 in the report and have been converted to millions for this JSON. Minor discrepancies in rounded figures in the report (e.g. 4,828 vs 4,848) have not been reconciled.
